_comment: Edit any value here and reload the game. No script changes needed. Keys starting with '_comment' are documentation only — the game ignores them.
Frednic uses a gaze meter that drains when ignored and fills when watched.
roam_interval       — seconds between teleports to a new cam while idle
meter_drain_rate    — meter falls this much per second when NOT watched
meter_fill_rate     — meter rises this much per second when watched
meter_min/max       — bounds of the meter (usually 0.0 and 1.0)
meter_start         — starting value; 0.5 is the safe middle
danger_low          — meter at/below this → he enters the office (player ignored him)
danger_high         — meter at/above this → he enters the office (player stared too long)
start_cam           — cam he resets to after being repelled
Bronnie walks a fixed left/right door route and forces the door open at the end.
move_interval         — flat seconds between route steps (used when AI scaling is off)
move_interval_base    — base seconds when AI scaling is on
move_interval_min     — lower clamp on the scaled interval
ai_level_multiplier   — seconds shaved off per AI level: final = base - ai_level * mult
return_delay          — seconds before turning around after the mask is equipped
start_cam             — cam she starts and resets to
Dave picks one of three routes at the start of each run and is blocked by closed doors.
move_interval / base / min / ai_level_multiplier — same scaling rules as Bronnie
return_delay         — seconds he pauses at the door before retreating when blocked
start_cam            — cam he starts and resets to
route_chances        — probabilities for each route, must sum to 1.0
left_door          — via CAM_05
left_door_alt      — via CAM_09
right_door         — right side approach
Rena escalates through three CAM_11 poses, then picks the window or right-door route.
move_interval / base / min / ai_level_multiplier — same scaling rules as the others
return_delay         — seconds before she heads back to CAM_11 after being blocked
start_cam            — cam she starts and resets to
window_route_chance  — probability of the window route; right-door route is the remainder
Ambassador occupies multiple cams at once and jumpscares if the player lowers the monitor while she is visible too many times.
move_time_min/max     — random seconds she stays on a single cam before moving
max_spawn_count       — max simultaneous cams she can occupy (actual = randi 1..this)
strikes_to_jumpscare  — strikes below this brick the current cam; reaching this triggers jumpscare
Fredbear plays a trumpet warning, then walks into the office. The player must hit the gaze button enough times before the deadline.
warning_interval                  — flat seconds between trumpet warnings (used when AI scaling is off)
warning_interval_base/min         — base and lower clamp when AI scaling is on
warning_interval_ai_multiplier    — seconds shaved off per AI level for warning interval
warning_gaze_time                 — seconds after the trumpet before he enters the office
gaze_deadline                     — flat seconds to complete the gaze button (used when AI scaling is off)
gaze_deadline_base/min            — base and lower clamp when AI scaling is on
gaze_deadline_ai_multiplier       — seconds shaved off per AI level for gaze deadline
gaze_required_base                — base button presses needed to repel him
gaze_required_per_ai_level        — extra presses per AI level; total = base + ai_level * this
marker_step_time                  — seconds at each forward marker as he walks into the office
walk_back_step_time               — seconds at each marker as he retreats after being repelled
